article.title: Moving from the Outside, In: Socialists Legislating With the Grassroots
article.author: Paul Pinsky
article.content: As an increasing number of democratic socialists and progressives run for and win state and local offices, they need a roadmap for how to strategize, organize and thrive once they get there. It’s easy to feel isolated and rudderless, particularly without leftwing colleagues to caucus with. I’m here to help. I’ve been an activist all my life—an anti-war protester, a union organizer… Source
